codesentinel.backendMode.description: Backend execution mode: local self-contained runtime or remote cloud endpoint.

codesentinel.cloudEndpoint.description: Remote cloud endpoint URL when running in cloud mode.

codesentinel.opencodePath.description: Executable path for the OpenCode CLI.

codesentinel.autoLaunchOpenCode.description: Automatically open OpenCode session when a workspace repository is loaded.

codesentinel.autoProvisionCloudSecurityA.description: Automatically provision the Cloud Security Audit skill to OpenCode (.opencode/skills/cloud-security-audit) upon workspace load.

codesentinel.mcpTimeout.description: Maximum per-tool execution timeout in milliseconds for OpenCode MCP tools (default: 600000ms / 10 minutes).

codesentinel.openCodeEnabled.description: Enable or disable OpenCode as the default UI agent harness in CodeSentinel Control Center.

codesentinel.multiRepoEnabled.description: Enable multi-repository support, allowing CodeSentinel to track, scan, and test multiple repositories simultaneously.

codesentinel.gitAutoSyncEnabled.description: Automatically detect Git branch changes and delta-sync Atlas Code Graph without re-indexing from scratch.

codesentinel.defaultAgentHarness.description: Default AI agent harness for ticket workflows and terminal execution (Claude Code, Antigravity / Gemini CLI, OpenCode, Cursor).

codesentinel.branchNamingTemplate.description: Branch naming template for Jira ticket checkout (tokens: ${ticketKey}, ${slug}, ${issueType}).

enumDescriptions: No Jira. Start work from a custom task description.
CodeSentinel calls the Jira REST API itself with the host, email and API token configured below.

Direct Atlassian connection when you have clicked 'Connect Jira' (browser sign-in); otherwise the agent harness reads and updates tickets headlessly with `claude -p`, which needs an Atlassian MCP server registered locally (`claude mcp add`).
codesentinel.jira.mode.description: How Jira is integrated: disabled, manual (host + email + API token), or harness (the AI agent uses its own Jira connection).

codesentinel.jira.harnessAllowedTools.description: Claude Code tool-name prefixes of the Jira/Atlassian MCP server the harness may use in harness mode. Adjust to match the server name shown by `claude mcp list`.

codesentinel.jira.projectKey.description: Default Jira project key (e.g. SEC, PROJ).

codesentinel.jira.jqlFilter.description: Custom JQL filter for ticket feed.

codesentinel.testing.playwrightEnabled.description: Enable Playwright frontend E2E browser testing in the testing matrix.

codesentinel.testing.apiTestingEnabled.description: Enable stage & API endpoint testing with injected secrets.

codesentinel.testing.stageDeployMode.description: Stage deployment mode before API testing: manual, auto (run command), or disabled.

codesentinel.testing.stageDeployCommand.description: Shell command to deploy stage environment when stageDeployMode is auto.

codesentinel.workflow.useWorktrees.description: Run each ticket in its own git worktree so several tickets/agents can work on one repo in parallel.

codesentinel.workflow.maxFixIterations.description: Maximum scan → verify → fix cycles before the workflow stops and asks for a human.

codesentinel.workflow.autoPush.description: Push the feature branch automatically when every gate passes. When false the workflow stops before pushing and waits for approval.

codesentinel.workflow.requirePlanApprova.description: Used only when workflow.pauseMode is 'none'. With 'gates' or 'every_stage' the plan always waits for approval.

codesentinel.workflow.agentTimeoutMinute.description: Maximum minutes for a single headless agent step.

codesentinel.workflow.baseBranches.description: Base branches offered when cutting a ticket branch (per-repo config overrides).

codesentinel.testing.stageApiBaseUrl.description: Base URL for stage API testing.

enumDescriptions: Pause for plan approval and before pushing (default).
Also pause after every stage so you can review before the next agent starts.
No plan approval; still stops before pushing unless auto-push is on.
codesentinel.workflow.pauseMode.description: When ticket workflows stop and wait for you.

codesentinel.workflow.jiraStageComments.description: Post a progress comment on the Jira ticket after each stage (plan, development, tests, push) when Jira is enabled.

codesentinel.agent.model.claude-code.description: Model for Claude Code agent runs: an alias (sonnet, opus, haiku), a full model ID, or empty for the CLI's own default. Defaults to sonnet; opus is never used unless you set it.

codesentinel.agent.model.gemini-antigrav.description: Model passed to `agy --model`. Default is gemini-3.8-flash.

codesentinel.agent.model.opencode.description: Model passed to `opencode run --model` as provider/model (for example opencode/big-pickle, opencode/glm-5.3-flash-free or anthropic/claude-3-7-sonnet).

codesentinel.agent.roleModels.description: Optional per-stage model override, keyed by planner, developer, tester, fixer or ticket. Example: {"planner": "opus", "developer": "sonnet"}.

codesentinel.jira.mcpUrl.description: Atlassian MCP endpoint used by 'Connect Jira'. Empty uses https://mcp.atlassian.com/v1/mcp.

codesentinel.agent.effort.claude-code.description: Reasoning effort for Claude Code agent runs (--effort).

codesentinel.agent.effort.gemini-antigra.description: Reasoning effort for Antigravity (agy) agent runs (--effort).

codesentinel.agent.roleEfforts.description: Optional per-stage effort override keyed by planner, developer, tester, fixer or ticket. Example: {"planner": "high", "developer": "medium"}.

codesentinel.workflow.stages.description: Turn individual ticket-workflow stages on or off: pull_ticket, cut_branch, plan, develop, diff_scan, verify_test, stage_test, playwright_test, push_branch. A disabled stage is skipped. Missing keys mean enabled.
